judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass Senate Bill 3EX as rewritten in the House. It sets up a nine-member committee to design a new statewide voting system that uses hand-marked paper ballots, and it bars the current Secretary of State from helping choose or buy that system. It also orders a hand recount when a close statewide race is decided by half a point or less, and the state pays counties back. The Georgia House passed it 94-79, and it became law.
